concept: An icon button is a small round pane with Button's material at the size of a glyph. It has the gloss, the rim and a glint under the pointer, and only the loud kind rests on a shadow.

root.why: a small round pane with the pane rim brightest at the top left

hit.why: a press area at least 44px each way around both sizes of disc

md.why: 36px, the default disc in toolbars and headers

sm.why: 32px for dense action rows, with the 44px press area kept

glass.why: glass with a white gloss across the top, blurred so the glyph reads over any photo

ghost.why: the glyph alone for dense rows, so quiet actions stay text-like

hover.why: the glint shows under the pointer; a quiet control does not lift

active.why: a press shrinks the disc slightly, faster than hover

focus-visible.why: keyboard focus draws the shared ring with its halo, visible on any scene

disabled.why: disabled uses the native attribute and the shared disabled opacity

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours drop rim, glint and fill, so a real system-colour border keeps the shape

transform.why: the press runs at press pace, a reply to the reader

color.why: the ghost glyph brightens at hover pace when the pointer arrives

opacity.why: the glint fades in and out at hover pace

default_to_avoid.pattern: a grey circle behind a glyph that tints on hover (Material icon button, every toolbar)
default_to_avoid.why_not: it is a flat disc with no edge and no light, so beside Pane's buttons it reads as a different, cheaper object

derivation.consequence: a soft shadow below and a rim of light on the top-left edge say where the pane floats
derivation.form: the disc carries the pane rim, brightest at the top left, and the loud kind rests on its own shadow

derivation.consequence: the rim and sheen are white at low opacity, like light catching an edge
derivation.form: a white gloss across the top half of the disc

derivation.consequence: nothing moves on its own; every motion answers something the reader did
derivation.form: a glint sits under the pointer and is gone when it leaves

derivation.consequence: every target is at least 44px in its smaller dimension or has a 44px hit area
derivation.form: the small size keeps a 44px hit area around a 32px disc

variants.reason: A is Button B at the size of a glyph, so a row of icon buttons and buttons reads as one family of objects (P3). B shows only a glyph at rest, so the target is invisible until hovered, which fails a reader who cannot hover. C widens the target but breaks the round shape a single glyph asks for.
